description: Primary ATT&CK Navigator layer showing only the five genuine implemented detection mappings in SentinelForge AI. Parent roll-up techniques (T1110, T1059, T1204) are NOT included as independent detections. Catalogue membership is not detection coverage. ATT&CK version v20.1.
name: SentinelForge AI — Implemented Detection Coverage

techniques.comment: STATUS: Implemented detection | RULE: sentinelforge.detection.suspicious_powershell | CONFIDENCE: medium | RATIONALE: PowerShell process execution with suspicious indicators (encoded command, execution policy bypass, download-and-execute) is consistent with T1059.001, but benign administrative PowerShell usage can also contain encoded commands. | CATALOGUE VERSION: v20.1 | RECOMMENDATIONS: Decode encoded commands; Check user account activity; Review PowerShell transcription logs; Isolate host if command is malicious

STATUS: Implemented detection | RULE: sentinelforge.detection.c2_beacon | CONFIDENCE: medium | RATIONALE: Periodic outbound connections with non-standard ports and suspicious process context are consistent with C2 beaconing, but legitimate periodic traffic (EDR heartbeats, software updates) can produce identical patterns. T1071 is only mapped when protocol-specific C2 context is present. | CATALOGUE VERSION: v20.1 | RECOMMENDATIONS: Correlate with process execution events on source host; Check destination reputation; Review command-line context; Compare against baseline network behavior

STATUS: Implemented detection | RULE: sentinelforge.detection.failed_login_burst | CONFIDENCE: high | RATIONALE: Multiple failed authentication attempts against one account within a time window is the exact definition of password guessing against live authentication. | CATALOGUE VERSION: v20.1 | RECOMMENDATIONS: Check for successful logins from source IP; Force password reset for targeted accounts; Review account lockout thresholds

STATUS: Implemented detection | RULE: sentinelforge.detection.password_spray | CONFIDENCE: high | RATIONALE: One source IP attempting authentication against multiple distinct usernames is the exact definition of password spraying. The PasswordSprayRule groups failures by source IP and counts distinct target usernames. | CATALOGUE VERSION: v20.1 | RECOMMENDATIONS: Check for successful logins from source IP against targeted accounts; Force password reset for targeted accounts; Review account lockout thresholds

STATUS: Implemented detection | RULE: sentinelforge.detection.suspicious_processtree | CONFIDENCE: medium | RATIONALE: Parent-child process correlation (Office → PowerShell) plus correlated file activity can indicate malicious file execution. The SuspiciousProcessTreeRule maps T1204.002 when correlated file activity (create/download/open) exists on the same host/user within the time window. | CATALOGUE VERSION: v20.1 | RECOMMENDATIONS: Check email attachments and web downloads; Review parent process context; Isolate host if malicious; Check for additional spawned processes
